title: DR1's hub always shows the animal and package totals, reading zero when nothing has been added; the frontend hides the whole "Your commodities" panel until a commodity exists.

finding.frontend: On a notification with no commodity chosen the hub goes straight from the "Overview" heading to "1. About the consignment" — there is no "Your commodities" heading and no counter cards anywhere in the rendered page. The panel is behind a condition (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/hub/template.njk:8-26) fed by a builder that returns nothing when the commodity collection is empty (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/hub/controller.js:142-146). Once a commodity line exists the panel appears, showing 0 animals and 0 packages until the quantities are filled in.
finding.prototype: DR1's hub renders the "Your commodities" heading and both cards on every visit, and prints "0" when there is nothing to count (app/routes.js:5746-5747). The captured hub, with nothing answered at all, shows 0 Animals and 0 Packages/boxes above the task list.
finding.difference: Render the totals panel unconditionally, showing zero for both counts when there are no commodity lines. That is the condition in template.njk:8 and the null return in controller.js:142-146; the sum helpers already produce 0 for an empty list. The user-facing point is that the hub keeps the same shape from the first visit rather than growing a section part way through.
finding.falsifiedBy: A frontend hub rendered with no commodity lines that still shows the "Your commodities" heading and the two counter cards.
